people.imagined: The armillary hall at night, the great rings above. The ancient head tilts his bald head back and looks at a visitor as if the person were slightly out of focus and the sky behind them were not.
people.subject: The moment: under the dim brass rings of an armillary he tips his bald head back and gazes at the viewer with a vague, far-focused stare, as if the real thing were behind them. Face (most important: the bald head and the dried-riverbed lines): a very small, very old face like a dried river bed, cracked all over with deep fine wrinkles, a domed bald head spotted with age, a tiny sharp nose, pale unfocused grey eyes under no eyebrows, a wide thin closed mouth; about ninety. Hair: none, a bald head, a short wispy white goatee. Body: small, frail, bent, dwarfed by his robe. Clothing: a robe of yellow-brown cloth the colour of dry grass, clean, cross collar, wide sleeves, a plain sash; in the topknot position nothing; at the neck a thin cord with a dark star-iron rod hanging as a pendant. Hands and objects: a small black stone mirror in a bronze rim held in both hands at his chest; in his belt a staff bearing seven tiny flags in a line. Background: a dim hall of enormous brass rings, circles within circles, blurred, a slit of night sky. Light: dim cool light from the upper left, a thread of silver on the rings. Expression: remote, patient, a little amused. A faint pale amber-gold Light hint on the mirror. Palette: dry-grass yellow-brown, brass, night blue.

people.imagined: On the armillary's winding platform at dusk. She turns the star-iron ring on her finger as she tells someone, in an even voice, what she is going to carry to the Pivot's court in open session.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stone platform at dusk, turning a dark ring on her finger as she speaks firmly. Face: a long, honest, upright face with a high forehead, a straight nose, level dark eyes under straight brows, a firm mouth; weathered skin, a few lines at the eyes; about fifty. Hair: black, with silver at the temples, in a tight topknot held by a short dark star-iron pin. Not a strand is loose, and the pin is set exactly vertical. Body: tall, straight, long-necked, poised. Clothing: a robe of brass-grey cloth with sleeves bound at the wrist with cord so they cannot catch, cross collar, a belt; a short cloak of yellow-brown wool over the shoulders; neat. Hands and objects: ink-stained cuffs clearly visible; a ring of dull dark star iron turned by her left thumb; in her right a ring of twelve small pennants on a short staff. Background: the pale bronze arcs of an armillary against a violet dusk, blurred. Light: low violet dusk from the left, a warm edge on the face. The brass arcs of the armillary behind her catch a long band of violet and gold. Expression: stern, just, impatient. A faint ochre-gold Earth and Metal hint round the ring. Palette: brass grey, yellow-brown, dusk violet.

people.imagined: On the plateau road beside a cart of star-iron discs, he winds his measuring cord round his neck again and beams at a granary master, calculating how soon he can ring every granary in the land.
people.subject: The moment: beside a loaded cart, he beams at a customer off-frame, rubbing his hands, a measuring cord looped round his neck. Face: a round, busy, ruddy face with plump cheeks, a short thick nose, small quick brown eyes, a wide smiling mouth with a hard greedy edge; a double chin; about forty-five. Hair: black, in a short topknot, a star-iron pin. Body: round, short, brisk, bouncing on small feet. His belly pushes against the belt and his short legs are planted wide; the chin is tucked and the eyebrows raised in salesman's good cheer. Clothing: a clean robe of yellow-brown cloth, belted high over the belly, sleeves rolled, a small leather apron; a plain sash. The robe has a stiff stand-up collar edged with a thin black band, and the sleeve cuffs are turned back twice to show a lining of pale undyed cotton; the leather apron has a long pocket holding a bundle of knotted measuring cords. Hands and objects: a long knotted measuring cord looped round the neck and hanging to the chest; the right hand holds a dark disc of star iron with a ring pattern; behind, a cart stacked with similar dark grey discs. A short bronze hammer hangs from his belt on a thong, and a round paper tag is tied to the cord at his neck. Background: a wide plateau road, dry yellow plain and a pale sky, blurred. Far behind him a train of carts and tiny figures crosses the dry plain, and one slim column of dust rises. Light: bright dry light from the upper left. The dry light throws a short hard shadow under his chin and glints on the dark discs. Expression: jovial, shrewd, cruel at the edges. A faint ochre Earth and silver Metal hint. Palette: yellow-brown, star-iron grey, sky pale.

people.imagined: The reed hut by the lake at night. She is sitting on the shore with her eyes on a reflected patch of water where a star should be, and has just heard a step behind her and not turned.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a dark lake shore at night in profile, eyes fixed on a patch of water, not turning her head at a footstep. Face (most important: very pale, unseen by day): a pale, quiet, long face the colour of milk, fine cheekbones, large dark eyes with a faint silver glint, narrow level brows, a small mouth; about thirty-five. Hair: black, long, loose to the waist, a few strands wet from mist, tied at the end with reed cord. Beads of mist cling to the ends of the long black hair. Body: slight, still, wrapped. Clothing: a clean robe of yellow-brown cloth, cross collar, long sleeves, a plain sash, a grey wool shawl round the shoulders. Hands and objects: a round dark mirror held in the lap, its surface showing a few small points of light; a tea bowl beside her; a lit oil lamp on a stone. Background: a still black lake with a scatter of stars reflected in it, a low reed hut, blurred. Light: a pale starlit blue from above left, silver on the water. A faint silver ripple of reflected stars lies across her cheek. Expression: still, attentive, worried. A faint pale silver Water hint round the mirror. Palette: night blue, silver, lamp yellow.

people.imagined: At the mine mouth, a disc of star iron in his hand rings with a clear note and he hums along without noticing, heavy and slow and quite happy.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of a mine he holds up a dark iron disc and taps it, humming along with its ringing note, eyes closed. Face: a heavy, slow, broad face with a thick jaw, small half-closed brown eyes, thick brows, a flat nose, a mouth open humming; stubble; about forty-five. Hair: black, cropped short, dusty. Body: heavy, thick, slow, powerful shoulders. The neck is thick and the head is tilted a little toward the disc as if he were listening to a friend; one boot is set on a stone. Clothing: a clean robe of yellow-brown cloth worn with a leather mining apron and iron-studded cuffs, a rope belt; dust at the hem. The apron is cracked leather with iron rivets at the corners, and the studded cuffs have a dull blue shine from heat; the robe underneath has a neat matching panel at the elbow. Hands and objects: a dark grey disc of star iron held in the left hand and tapped with a small hammer in the right; at his feet a sack of identical discs. His knuckles are scarred and blackened, and a small bag of barley hangs at the belt. Background: Behind him loose rails of an ore tramway run into the dark mouth, a few small carts sit, and a thin flock of birds crosses the pale sky. Light: bright dry light from the upper left, a faint silver glint on the disc. A sliver of sunlight reaches the disc and shows a faint ring of iridescent colour on its face. Expression: content, dreamy, hiding a little. A faint silver Metal ring-shimmer round the disc. Palette: iron grey, ochre, pale blue.

people.imagined: The chart room, lamp lit. He squints one milky eye through a rock-crystal lens at an old chart pinned beside a new sailor's chart, and has not yet decided whom to trust.
people.subject: The moment: peering through a rock-crystal lens held up to one milky eye at an old chart, suspicious. Face (most important: one milky white eye): a thin, narrow, suspicious face with a hooked nose, one eye clouded entirely milky white, the other black and sharp, squinting through a round crystal lens, grey bristly brows, a thin down-turned mouth; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, thin, in a small topknot with a star-iron pin. Body: lean, hunched over the table, crabbed. One shoulder is higher than the other from a lifetime at a low table, and his neck juts forward like a heron's. Clothing: a robe of yellow-brown cloth with ink-stained sleeves, a high collar, a plain belt; neat. The long sleeves are tied at the wrist with black cord so they will not smear the charts, and the collar is fastened to the throat by a single bone button; the sash holds a roll of fine paper strips. Hands and objects: a rock-crystal lens on a short handle in the right hand; a chart of dark paper with white pin-pricks of stars on the table, and beside it a second chart in a different hand; a jar of small marked tokens. The nails on the right hand are cut very short, the fingertips grey with chalk. Background: a dim chart room, rolled maps on shelves, blurred. On the wall hangs a long dark chart dotted with white stars, and beside it a second chart in a new brighter ink, sailors' coastlines drawn in blue. Light: lamp from the lower right, shadow on half of the face. The lamp makes the milky eye shine like a pearl. Expression: suspicious, paranoid, absorbed. A faint amber Earth hint. Palette: parchment brown, ink black, lamp amber.

people.imagined: On the plateau, laying a ward ring in the dust with his loud laugh startling the lake geese; he has just been told a richer camp sent for him and is half-grinning toward the road.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a half-laid circle of star-iron discs, mid-laugh, one foot already turned toward a road. Face: a long, brown, lively face with a wide mouth open in a booming laugh, bright dark eyes, thick brows, a prominent nose, high cheekbones; about twenty. Hair: black, tousled, tied up with a bit of yak-hair cord. Body: tall, lanky, loose-limbed, energetic. He leans on one hip with a bounce in his heel, as if he is going to start walking at any moment, and his Adam's apple is prominent. Clothing: a clean robe of yellow-brown cloth with sleeves rolled to the elbow, a rope belt, a leather satchel; straw sandals. The yellow-brown robe has been shortened at the hem so it does not drag in the dust, and the sleeves are stitched with a double seam; a travel satchel of grey felt hangs across the chest. Hands and objects: in the right hand a small dark flag on a stick; the left holding a dark star-iron disc; a ring of discs laid out in the dust at his feet. A scrap of paper with a rough circle diagram sticks out of the satchel. Background: a wide yellow plain, a lake with a flock of geese taking off, blurred. Behind him a few small black yaks graze at the edge of the lake, a distant line of low hills, and one tall flag-pole at a camp. Light: bright sun from the upper left. The geese beat up a glitter of spray in the sunlight behind him. Expression: loud, ambitious, careless. A faint ochre Earth glimmer. Palette: plain yellow, star-iron grey, goose white.

people.imagined: The scriptorium at night; the broad forearms of a cook's daughter push out of narrow copyist's sleeves as she copies. She stops and looks up, her mind elsewhere with her mother out on the plain.
people.subject: The moment: in a scriptorium she looks up from a copying desk, brush paused, her thoughts on someone far away. Face (most important: broad cook's forearms in narrow copyist's sleeves): a plain, honest, round face with a wide forehead, clear brown eyes, soft straight brows, a short nose, a mouth pressed; about twenty-five. Hair: black, in a neat bun with a bamboo pin, a smudge of ink on the temple. Body: sturdy, wide-shouldered, thick-armed. Her wrists rest on the table in a way that shows the width of her forearms, and her back is a little rounded from long copying. Clothing: a robe of yellow-brown cloth with narrow tight sleeves that stop short of the wrists, so her thick forearms stick out, ink on the cuffs, a belt. The robe is plainly cut with a high collar fastened to the chin, and the ink stains run in thin lines down the inner sleeve where she wipes the brush; the belt is a plain strip of undyed cloth. Hands and objects: a brush held over a page of pale paper marked only with small repeated circles; large forearms resting on the desk edge; a small lamp. A copy of a book lies open before her, its pages covered with neat black circles within circles and tiny hatch-marks. Background: a quiet room with a shelf of bound books, blurred. On the wall behind her a shelf holds a dozen identical bound volumes, a clay water-dropper and a small wooden figure of a yak. Light: lamp from the upper left. The lamp throws her shadow tall on the wall. Expression: honest, diligent, sorrowing. A faint ochre Earth hint. Palette: yellow-brown, ink black, paper cream.

people.imagined: At dusk on the lake path with a pot of butter tea for the watcher; she talks low as if the wind were listening, tea staining her sleeve, a yak plodding behind.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a lake shore at dusk, holding a covered tea pot against her chest and speaking in a low voice. Face: a round, cheerful, wind-reddened face with high pink cheeks, bright dark eyes, a snub nose, a small smiling mouth; about seventeen. Hair: black, in two thick braids with red wool, a wool cap. Body: sturdy, small, bundled, quick on her feet. She walks leaning slightly forward into the wind with the pot held tight, her steps short and quick, a small bundled shape. Clothing: a clean yellow-brown wool robe with a long sleeve stained with tea down one side, a sash, a sheepskin vest; felt boots. The sheepskin vest is turned fleece-side-in with an edge of grey wool showing at the neck and arm-holes, and the felt boots are embroidered with a thin red zigzag; the wool cap has ear flaps tied under her chin. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round a round clay tea pot wrapped in cloth; a shaggy yak with a wooden bell plodding in the background. A second smaller cup hangs on a cord from her belt, ready for the watcher. Background: a dark lake and reed hut with a thin light, dusk, blurred. In the distance a single yak with long fringed hair stands among the reeds, and a faint light shows in the window of a hut. Light: low pink dusk light from the upper left. The last pink light edges the clouds and tints the steam rising from the pot. Expression: warm, shy, brave. A faint ochre warmth. Palette: tea brown, dusk pink, wool cream.

people.imagined: The mine workshop, the discs ringing round him. He is half asleep, lids drooping mid-sentence, and his answer arrives a breath after the question; he smiles lazily.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a ringing workshop with heavy drooping eyelids, about to answer a question out of frame, a lazy smile. Face (most important: heavy drooping lids): a soft, round, sleepy face with half-closed brown eyes under drooping lids, thick soft brows, a snub nose, a slow lazy smile; about twenty-two. Hair: dark brown, floppy, uncombed, tied back with a bit of cord. Body: soft, broad, slouching against a bench. His belly is round and his knees are soft, leaning his hip on the bench and propped on one elbow, nearly asleep on his feet. Clothing: a clean yellow-brown cloth tunic, leather apron, sleeves rolled, a rope belt. The apron has a split at one pocket that has been mended with blue thread, and a scrap of angelica root is tucked behind his belt; the tunic collar is open and crumpled. Hands and objects: a small hammer loosely in the right hand; a dark star-iron disc lying on the bench in front of him; several more on a rack. His left hand rests on a disc, his thumb absently stroking its rim. Background: a workshop with hanging discs and tools, blurred. On racks behind him hang a dozen dark discs of different sizes on cords, each slightly swinging, with a small tuning fork on a stand. Light: soft light from the upper left. A pale ring of light from a high window falls on his hair. Expression: lazy, forgiving, content. A faint silver Metal ring in the air. Palette: iron grey, ochre, soft brown.

people.imagined: By lamplight in the carving shed, a bow-legged wheelwright's son cuts a tiny date into the rim of a spare armillary ring, in the old hand, for the head, careful and quiet.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a metal ring in lamplight, carving a tiny mark into its rim with a fine chisel, tongue between his teeth. Face: a narrow, serious, boyish face with a high forehead, dark careful eyes, soft brows drawn together, a long nose, a tongue-tip between his lips; about seventeen. Hair: black, shaggy, tied with a cord. Body: short, thin, bow-legged stance, hunched. His thighs bow outward, and his shoulders hunch over the work with his elbows pressed to his ribs. Clothing: a clean yellow-brown tunic with a leather apron, sleeves rolled, a rope belt. The apron has a loop on the left side holding three chisels of increasing size, and his sleeves are bound at the wrist with leather thongs; the tunic is pale with a little scorch at the hem. Hands and objects: a fine chisel in the right hand and a small mallet in the left; a dark brass-grey armillary ring clamped on a stand; wood shavings. His thumb has a flat callus from the mallet, and a fine curl of metal falls from the chisel. Background: a carving shed with ring parts on racks, blurred. On the shelf behind him sit three small wooden models of rings, a measuring staff and an hour-glass, and rolls of rubbing paper stand in a jar. Light: a lamp from the lower right, bright on the ring. The lamp reflects in the ring's polished edge as a narrow gold line. Expression: diligent, humble, secretive. A faint ochre Earth hint. Palette: brass, shaving yellow, shadow brown.

people.imagined: The year he founded the abbey, a yak herder who watched the sky for fifty years before he cultivated: he stands on the high plain at night, a staff in hand, face turned up to the stars, just beginning to understand.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A herder stands on an empty high plain under stars, head tilted back, a staff in his hand. Face: a long, weathered, kind face, sunburnt to leather, deep creases, a long nose, large dark eyes full of wonder, grey bushy brows, a thin grey beard, a mouth open slightly; about sixty. Hair: grey, long, tied in a topknot with a leather thong. Body: tall, lean, sturdy, wiry from years outdoors. Clothing: a long robe of coarse yak wool in yellow-brown, clean, belted with a rope, a sheepskin vest over it, felt boots; a wool cap pushed back. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a tall wooden staff; the left hand raised, a finger pointing at the stars; a small bell at his belt; a yak's dark shape beside him. The wind lifts the hem of his robe and the tips of his grey hair, and his breath rises in the cold in a small, slow cloud. Background: an empty plain, a lake with a faint dipper of stars reflected, a vast night sky, blurred. Light: pale starlight from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: wonder, humble devotion. A faint pale-gold glimmer in his eyes. Palette: faded brown, night blue, pale gold.

people.imagined: The year he went blind, leading his star-readers across the plain to Củng Tinh with their charts; an old man with a proud blank stare, one hand on a young reader's shoulder and the other clutching a rolled chart.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A blind old head walks forward proudly with a hand on a young person's shoulder, a roll of charts under his arm. Face: a proud, gaunt, aquiline face with a hooked nose, a high forehead, blank white clouded eyes staring straight ahead, thick white brows, a thin tight mouth, a long white beard; about eighty. Hair: white and long, swept back from a high forehead under a black cap. Body: tall, thin, upright, rigid with pride. Clothing: a long robe of dark blue-grey cloth embroidered at the edges with tiny stars, clean though dusty from the road, a wide dark sash; a heavy cloak. Hands and objects: the left hand on a young reader's shoulder, the right arm clutching a bundle of rolled dark charts speckled with white points, tied with cord; a long staff. Background: a pale road across a high plain, a few robed readers following, blurred. Light: pale light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. A weak pale light lies along the proud line of his nose and the blank white of his eyes. Expression: proud, blind, honest. A faint dark blue shimmer. Palette: faded blue-grey, bone white, dust.

people.imagined: The array hall counting table; he reaches for a coin and every silver-wire ring on his fingers clicks. He smiles, genial, short of a coin in the lay widows' pay.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a counting table he reaches for a coin, his many rings clicking, with a genial smile. Face: a round, friendly, shrewd face with bright small brown eyes, a wide smiling mouth, a short moustache, a plump chin; about forty. Hair: black, oiled and in a topknot with a star-iron pin. Body: plump, jovial, relaxed. He leans forward on one elbow with a plump hand open and his belly resting on the table edge, relaxed and at ease. Clothing: a clean robe of yellow-brown cloth with a silk-lined collar, belted, a small leather purse; sleeves pushed back. The collar of the robe is lined with pale grey silk and fastened by a small silver toggle; the sleeves are turned back with cuffs of the same grey and a cord of silver thread edges the sash. Hands and objects: a thin silver-wire ring on every finger except the thumbs, eight rings glinting, plainly visible; a stack of small silver coins in front of him; an open plain book beside them. The rings are all thin and plain, each wound of silver wire, and each of them differently twisted. Background: a dim hall with ring-array diagrams on the wall, blurred. On the wall behind him hangs a large painted diagram of nested circles and dots, with a bone abacus and a small iron strongbox on a shelf. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. The warm lamp makes the silver of the rings flash with every movement. Expression: genial, pragmatic, greedy. A faint silver Metal gleam. Palette: yellow-brown, silver, lamp amber.

people.imagined: A stone courtyard at dusk. She stands so long over the register before she writes a line that the novices call her the Heron; the brush hovers a long time, exactly poised.
people.subject: The moment: standing perfectly still over a register on a stone lectern, her brush hovering above the page like a heron about to strike. Face: a long, thin, composed face with a long straight nose, calm grey eyes fixed on the page, thin level brows, a thin closed mouth; about thirty-eight. Hair: black, in a tight low knot with a plain dark pin. Body: very tall, thin, long-necked and long-legged, standing on one foot slightly, heron-like. One foot is lifted slightly so that her weight rests on the other, and her neck is extended forward to read. Clothing: a clean robe of yellow-brown cloth, cross collar, long narrow sleeves, a plain belt; tidy as a pin. The long narrow sleeves are fastened with a button of dark iron at each wrist, the belt is a thin yellow-brown cord knotted at the front, and the hem of the robe is exactly straight. Hands and objects: a long brush held vertical, the tip hanging a hair above the page; a round bronze mirror at her belt; a lectern with a wide page of tiny marks. The register is bound in pale cloth and lies open to a column of small star-signs, and her left hand holds a little brass seal. Background: the stone courtyard with a pattern of seven stars set in the paving, dusk, blurred. The courtyard stones are set in a pattern of seven round dishes, one deeper than the rest, with a stone bench against a plain wall. Light: low violet light from the left. A last bar of violet sky is reflected in a shallow puddle at her feet. Expression: patient, honest, withdrawn. A faint pale-blue Water hint. Palette: yellow-brown, stone grey, dusk violet.

people.imagined: The lake shore at night, a boy trimming a lamp so it does not light the patch of water the watcher looks at. Lake birds settle near him, knowing his smell of yak butter and smoke.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the shore with a small lamp, carefully trimming the wick with a tiny blade, a heron and ducks settled calmly beside him. Face: a calm, round, trusting young face with soft brown eyes, thick brows, a broad nose, a small gentle smile; about seventeen. Hair: dark brown, thick, cut with a bowl, under a wool cap. Body: stocky, quiet, careful. He sits on his heels with his back curved, still as a stone, shoulders relaxed so that the birds do not fear him. Clothing: a clean yellow-brown wool robe with a sheepskin vest, a rope belt, felt boots. The sheepskin vest has leather trim at the elbows, the felt boots are stained with lake mud, and a bone toggle fastens the robe at the neck. Hands and objects: a small bronze lamp with a short flame in his left hand; a tiny trimming blade in the right; at his feet two ducks and a grey heron on the shore. A small leather pouch of lamp oil hangs at the belt, and his thumbs are blackened with soot. Background: a dark lake and reeds, a dim hut with a light, blurred. A line of reed tops wave in the night wind, the far shore shows one dim yellow window, and on the water floats the reflection of a few stars. Light: lamp from the lower left, warm on his face. The lamp throws a small trembling circle of gold on the shore stones. Expression: calm, trusting, diligent. A faint warm red Fire hint at the lamp. Palette: wool brown, night blue, lamp amber.

people.imagined: At the sorting heap, hefting a stone in her palm and speaking its weight aloud; she is never wrong, and is already setting the heaviest discs aside for a sack.
people.subject: The moment: on a heap of rubble she hefts a dark stone in her palm, eyes half closed as if listening, lips parted to say its weight. Face: a calm, straight face with a firm chin, steady grey eyes, level brows, a short nose, a composed mouth; about twenty-three. Hair: black, in a tight practical braid pinned round the head, dust in it. Body: strong, sturdy, a squarish stance, bare strong arms. Her feet are planted wide on the rubble and her shoulders are level, with a calm settled weight like a scale-pan. Clothing: a clean yellow-brown tunic with a stiff leather apron, sleeves rolled to the shoulder, a rope belt. The apron is cracked leather dyed brown with ore dust, with a wide pocket at the front holding a row of marked pebbles; a stripe of dark star-iron dust runs from her collar to her elbow. Hands and objects: a heavy dark star-iron stone resting in the right palm; before her on a cloth, a row of dark grey stones lined up by size; a small hand scale. On the cloth the stones are laid in a line from smallest to largest, each with a pinch of white chalk on its top. Background: a mine's spoil heap and a pale sky, blurred. Behind her are heaps of grey and brown spoil, a wheelbarrow, a wooden sorting table, and the dark mouth of the mine. Light: bright dry light from the upper left. A low sun lights the side of the stone in her hand to a dull blue-black sheen. Expression: calm, honest, sure. A faint silver Metal hint. Palette: stone grey, ochre, pale sky.

people.imagined: In the ink room, he sniffs the pot before he stirs it, thumbnails black as beetles, and says nothing about the extra star.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a pot of ink, sniffing it before he stirs it, with a quiet face. Face: a thin, pale, careful young face with large dark eyes, soft brows, a long nose wrinkled at the smell, a mouth pressed shut; a smear of ink on one cheek; about nineteen. Hair: black, tidy, in a knot. Body: narrow, stooped over the work. His shoulders are narrow and he leans on the table with his elbows out, his head bowed over the pot like a man at a well. Clothing: a clean yellow-brown tunic with ink-stained cuffs, an apron, a plain belt. The apron is canvas, grey with years of splashed ink, with a pocket of folded cloths; the tunic sleeves are pushed to the elbow and tied with a strip of paper. Hands and objects: both thumbnails stained black as beetles, clearly visible; a stirring stick in the right hand; a stone pot of dark ink; a lump of ink and a grinding stone. Beside the pot lie three ink sticks of different sizes, a chipped blue-white dish, and a small bundle of brushes. Background: a small ink room with shelves of pots, blurred. The shelves behind him hold neat rows of stoppered jars, each with a coloured thread tied round its neck in place of writing. Light: a lamp from the upper left. The lamp makes a bright disc on the black surface of the ink. Expression: humble, careful, silent. A faint dark blue shade in the ink. Palette: ink black, yellow-brown, paper cream.

people.imagined: On a ward-laying job at a farm, grinning with one silver tooth, counting silver coins; she has ringed the barley yard and, with a shrug, left the well outside.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a farm yard counting silver coins in her palm, grinning, a silver tooth glinting. Face (most important: one silver front tooth): a sharp, tanned, cheeky face with a pointed chin, narrow quick eyes, thin arched brows, a broad grin with one front tooth bright silver, a small scar through one brow; about twenty-one. Hair: black, in a high ponytail with a red cord. Body: slim, quick, confident. She stands with a hip cocked and her weight on the back foot, a quick relaxed bounce in her stance. Clothing: a clean yellow-brown tunic with a short leather jerkin, rolled sleeves, a belt with a hanging pouch; short trousers; boots. The jerkin is leather with the seams picked out in red thread, and a row of small iron studs runs down the front; the belt pouches are of different colours, one for each job. Hands and objects: a handful of silver coins held up; a small dark flag on a stick under her arm; behind her a farm barley yard ringed by dark star-iron discs set in the earth. The silver coins are stacked in a neat column between her finger and thumb, the top one tipped against the light. Background: a farmstead, a well outside the ring, blurred. A line of low earth walls round the barley yard, the farmer and a child watching from the doorway, and a cart waiting on the road. Light: bright light from the upper left. Bright sun glints in the silver tooth and on the coins. Expression: cheeky, ambitious, careless. A faint ochre Earth hint. Palette: yellow-brown, silver, barley gold.

people.imagined: At dawn, wiping an armillary ring with a cloth that always jumps from her hand; she has just chased it across the floor, laughing, smelling of angelica root.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she stretches to wipe a great dark metal ring while the wiping cloth slips out of her hand and flutters, laughing. Face: a small, round, freckled, merry face with big honest brown eyes, thick brows, a snub nose, a wide laughing mouth; about sixteen. Hair: dark brown, in two short braids with a twist of dry grass. Body: small, wiry, on tiptoe. She is stretched up with one foot off the floor and her free arm out for balance, a quick comical lunge. Clothing: a clean yellow-brown tunic with a white apron, short sleeves, a rope belt; a sprig of angelica tucked in the belt. The apron is white with a smear of brass polish across the front, and the sprig of angelica in her belt has small umbrella-shaped flower-heads; the sleeves are short and the cuffs are hemmed with a plain band. Hands and objects: one hand reaching for a cloth in mid-air above the floor; the other pressed against a dark star-iron ring many times her height. A tin of polish and a second cloth sit on the floor beside her. Background: The star-iron ring rises behind her like a great dark wall with polished bands, the slit window above shows a strip of pale sky. Light: pale pink dawn from the upper left. A bar of dawn light lies across the ring and makes a bright stripe where she has already wiped. Expression: merry, trusting, rueful. A faint pale-green Wood hint at the angelica. Palette: dawn pink, brass, yellow-brown.
